verdict.rationale: Docusign documents a built-in AI-powered chat in AI-Assisted Review that can review agreements, flag risky language, suggest edits and draft new language, plus ready-to-deploy review agents and AI Q&A for signers. Delegation is limited to contract analysis and drafting tasks. The MCP connectors serve external agents such as Claude and Gemini, so they are not credited as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: evidence the in-product assistant can carry out broader tasks such as sending envelopes or running workflows, detail on how the assistant behaves, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Review and analyze agreements, flag potentially risky language, suggest surgical edits, and draft new language from an intuitive AI-powered chat.
Review agreements against your playbooks and ready-to-deploy agents and get suggested redlines to align terms with your requirements.
AI-generated summaries and built-in Q&A give signers clarity faster so they can sign with confidence.
use AI to flag non-compliant clauses, suggest approved language, and draft new clauses on demand
